itens.trecho: Para mim, de longe, este é o pior filme dos Vingadores. Depois de uma sequência enorme de grandes acertos, este foi um verdadeiro escorregão da Marvel. O filme tem seus pontos positivos, claro: a dinâmica da equipe reunida no começo — como aquela cena descontraída na torre, que deixa um bom gancho para Vingadores: Ultimato — é muito boa.

A long form review originally posted in 2015: I’ve just returned from two back-to-back viewings of Avengers: Age of Ultron, and I do not regret one bit going in for that second helping. I lost my steam on the Age of Ultron wagon at a very inopportune moment. About three days before it came out.

The fact that Joss Whedon was able to salvage some sort of coherent film out of all he was forced to cram into a single movie is quite commendable. But the sad fact is that Avengers: Age of Ultron is really just a run of the mill "bad guy wants to destroy the world for reasons" actioner that we've seen done better many times before. Don't get me wrong.
